pipeline-lint

pipeline-lint reads your Airflow DAG files without running them and reports the mistakes that usually surface in production: tasks with retries but no retry delay, sensors in poke mode holding worker slots, missing catchup=False, and start dates computed from datetime.now().

pip install pipeline-lint
pipeline-lint dags/

Source and issues: github.com/noorhaldar-example/pipeline-lint.
